![medium](https://www.gstatic.com/codereviewagent/medium-priority.svg)

To enforce defensive programming and prevent potential runtime `TypeError`s, use optional chaining when accessing properties on the `session` object, as it may be null or undefined in some contexts.

```suggestion
      ?? session?.currentQuestionId,
```

![medium](https://www.gstatic.com/codereviewagent/medium-priority.svg)

If `fetchMsSourceRevealAsset` is called with an explicit `null` value, destructuring will throw a `TypeError`. Using a fallback default object on the parameter assignment or destructuring inside the function body ensures safer handling of null inputs. When refactoring to defensively handle nullish inputs, ensure that strictly required dependencies are not assigned default values that would mask missing arguments.

```javascript
export async function fetchMsSourceRevealAsset(params) {
  const { questionId, assetId, receipt } = params || {};
```

<details>
<summary>References</summary>

1. When refactoring functions to defensively handle nullish inputs (e.g., by defaulting the destructured parameter object to `{}`), ensure that strictly required dependencies are not assigned default values that would mask missing arguments, keeping them required.
</details>
Fixed in 0e083a9bd. The route contract fallback now uses `session?.currentQuestionId`, preserving the existing fallback behavior while avoiding a nullish-session property access.

Fixed in 0e083a9bd. `fetchMsSourceRevealAsset` now destructures `params || {}` so explicit `null` reaches the existing required-field validator instead of throwing a destructuring `TypeError`. Added a regression that verifies null params return `invalid_ms_source_reveal_request` without requesting a token or calling fetch.

Fixed in 0e083a9bd. The reveal handler now checks `isMountedRef.current` immediately after `fetchMsSourceRevealAsset(routeRequest)` resolves and returns before `URL.createObjectURL` when the page has unmounted. Added a page-route regression that resolves the reveal request after unmount and asserts no blob URL is created or revoked.
